label: About
title: About The Stick Across the Bubbles
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from a saved source, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: a visible mark in the scene opens the real source that shaped the day.

This edition began with one saved post, @GoodWillsmith: USBs from street markets in CDMX did not disappoint. all of them crammed with.... Its image from pbs.twimg.com set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Stick Across the Bubbles: Bootleg-cumbia bubble world: a flat top-down landscape plate of inflated airbrushed blob-masses in red-to-yellow, cyan and magenta-violet, thick black and blue halo outlines, cascading diagonally across acid lime-green. A single brushed-steel slab bridges the lower third, its round ring aperture glowing warm yellow. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped the source to Brushed-steel drive slab with glowing yellow ring aperture over bubble forms.

typography.rationale: Fraunces and Newsreader fit image-led art objects while Space Grotesk keeps process labels crisp.
